job.job_title: Playwright Automation Engineer - GenAI & API Testing
job.job_description:
We are looking for a skilled Playwright Automation Engineer with strong expertise in TypeScript-based test automation, API testing, and emerging AI-assisted testing practices. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in designing scalable automation frameworks, implementing end-to-end test solutions, and leveraging AI tools to improve quality engineering productivity. Strong communication skills and the ability to work directly with stakeholders are essential.




Role & responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks using Playwright and TypeScript.
Create and execute UI, API, integration, and regression test suites.
Develop reusable automation components and improve framework scalability and maintainability.
Perform API testing using tools such as Postman, Playwright API testing, REST Assured, or similar tools.
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and support DevOps-driven quality practices.
Leverage AI-assisted testing tools (Copilot, ChatGPT, AI-powered test generation, self-healing automation, etc.) to improve testing efficiency and coverage.
Analyze business requirements and translate them into automated test scenarios.
Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, product owners, developers, and QA teams.
Participate in test planning, estimation, defect triage, and release validation activities.
Prepare test status reports and communicate progress, risks, and quality metrics to stakeholders.




Preferred candidate profile

Playwright Automation

Strong hands-on experience with Playwright and TypeScript.
Experience automating web applications across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit browsers.
Knowledge of Page Object Model (POM), fixtures, hooks, and advanced Playwright features.
Experience creating scalable and maintainable automation frameworks.

API Testing

Strong understanding of RESTful APIs and microservices testing.
Experience validating API requests, responses, authentication mechanisms, and service integrations.
Hands-on experience with Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI, or Playwright API testing capabilities.

AI in QE / AI-Assisted Testing

Practical exposure to AI-enabled testing approaches.
Experience utilizing GenAI tools for:
Test case generation
Test data creation
Automation script development
Test optimization and analysis
Defect investigation and root cause analysis
Understanding of AI-driven quality engineering trends and best practices.

Communication & Stakeholder Management

Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to interact confidently with clients, business users, and leadership teams.
Experience presenting testing strategy, test status, and quality metrics to stakeholders.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
